reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it presents a specific $1,502-in-12-days mining claim alongside a displayed BITCLUB wallet balance and earnings figure, while describing Bitcoin investment as producing income and withdrawals. It solicits participation through network registration and invitations to invest or build a business, including minimum investments, capital multiplication, share purchases, commissions, and enrollment. the available video evidence does not establish that the displayed balance or earnings were genuine, that viewers paid or received funds, or what the registration destination would do.

citations.quote: $1,502 in the first 12 days of Bitcoin mining with Bitclub Network
But we invest in bitcoins.
true extraction of cryptocurrency
how can invest in bitcoin mine cryptocurrency

opening.argument: The presentation is framed as a personal account rather than a promise that every viewer will profit. The speaker says he is showing how he worked at BitClubNetwork, identifies when he joined, and expressly states that he made no sales or paid references. He also describes a particular account and withdrawal interface, leaving the viewer to assess the experience rather than guaranteeing an outcome. The available wording does not say that returns are risk-free, guaranteed, or inevitable for viewers; it reports what the speaker says happened in his own account.

citations.quote: I will show you how I worked at the company BitClubNetwork for more than 1500 dollars in all the first 12 days.
I joined the company on January 17, 2017.
I did not make any sales or paid any references to the company.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The displayed figure and the title identify a reported personal result, but neither establishes that viewers were promised the same result. The reference opening itself acknowledges that the evidence does not establish the displayed balance or earnings were genuine, which also means it does not establish deceptive certainty. Describing withdrawals and investment possibilities is compatible with discussing the claimed service, not proof of a false guarantee.

citations.quote: $1,502 in the first 12 days of Bitcoin mining with Bitclub Network
The withdrawal can be done at any time, withdrawal, which goes in a day.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A personal framing does not neutralize the concrete earnings representation. The title pairs a precise dollar amount with Bitcoin mining, while the account screen visibly presents an earnings summary of $1,502.06. The speaker also tells viewers how they can invest and mine cryptocurrency, so the material goes beyond a neutral disclaimer or private diary. The evidence need not prove that every viewer was guaranteed the same amount to show a promoted mining-return claim.

citations.quote: $1,502 in the first 12 days of Bitcoin mining with Bitclub Network
how can invest in bitcoin mine cryptocurrency

opening.argument: The strongest reading is a review and operational walkthrough of an account, not a certification of an investment opportunity. The title explicitly calls the material a review, and the narration moves through the company website, the speaker's account, balances, mining currencies, and withdrawal process. Showing an interface and explaining how the service is presented can be educational even when the speaker is enthusiastic. The footage therefore documents what the platform displays and how the account is used; it does not independently establish that the speaker is selling a guaranteed financial outcome.

citations.quote: Review by Alexander Sorokin | BeHappy24
So, the official company website. My account. Let's go and see.
the company pays us in bitcoins

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling something a review does not determine its substance. The narration says the speaker selected the company after analyzing more than 200 companies, then invites viewers to learn how to invest, mine, and build a business. The screen is not merely a technical tutorial: it is paired with a claimed mining income and an invitation to participate.

citations.quote: more than out of 200 companies we picked Bitclub Club Network
if you want to find out how can invest in bitcoin mine cryptocurrency
how can build a business

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The account walkthrough is persuasive precisely because it presents a concrete result as evidence for the service. The screen labels the section Bitcoin Wallet and shows an earnings summary, while the narration explains investing in bitcoins and earning in bitcoin. A review can still function as promotion when it directs viewers toward investment and business participation; the operational format does not remove that commercial message.

citations.quote: But we invest in bitcoins.
And the income is thus paid out in bitcoin.

opening.argument: Even accepting the presentation at face value, the supplied material does not show the core mechanics needed to call it a scam. It does not show a deposit being made, a fee being paid, a request for credentials, a failed withdrawal, or a guaranteed return. The speaker discusses a service account and says he did not make sales or paid references. The website view shows a wallet and a field for a payout address, but a static interface is not proof that money was solicited or that the service was fraudulent. At most, this is promotion or commentary about an external service whose safety the footage does not establish either way.

citations.quote: I did not make any sales or paid any references to the company.
The withdrawal can be done at any time, withdrawal, which goes in a day.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The absence of a completed transaction does not erase the solicitation. The description supplies a registration destination, and the narration invites contact, investment, mining, and business-building with minimum investments. The account display and precise mining-income claim provide the promotional hook even if the video does not show a viewer depositing funds or receiving a withdrawal.

citations.quote: Registration in Bitclub Network
how can invest in bitcoin mine cryptocurrency
minimum investments please contact

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing mechanics are not decisive because the video supplies the central mechanism in words: investment in bitcoins is linked to income, and viewers are told how to invest and mine. The registration destination and contact invitation give viewers a path to participate, while the wallet screen supplies a claimed result. Whether the service ultimately paid anyone is unresolved, but unresolved payment is different from evidence that no paid mining-return promotion occurred.
